scenes.say: Many loops get tuned once, at startup, and never looked at again. Valves wear, the process changes, and the loop quietly gets worse.
scenes.html:
Loops drift
Tuned once.
Never checked again.
Valves wear. The process changes.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: The fix is to measure it. Same test, same numbers, before and after every change.
scenes.html:
Measure it
Numbers,
not opinions.
Same test, before and after every change.

scenes.say: DatumLab connects to any OPC UA server: Kepware, FactoryTalk Linx Gateway, Ignition, Siemens S7-1500 or Beckhoff.
scenes.html:
Live tags, straight off the PLC
Kepware · FactoryTalk Linx Gateway · Ignition · S7-1500 · Beckhoff
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Double-click the tags you want and they stream into a live trend at a fixed rate.
scenes.html:
Fixed-rate sampling
Double-click a tag.
It streams live.
A fixed rate keeps FFTs and filters valid.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Pick the process variable and the setpoint, then run control-loop performance.
scenes.html:
Control-loop performance
Pick PV and SP. One click.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: You get the error scores, I A E, I S E and I T A E, plus time in band, with the error plotted underneath.
scenes.html:
Error scores
IAE · ISE · ITAE
plus time in band, with the error plotted
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Time in band is the plain-English one: how much of the run the variable actually stayed where you wanted it.
scenes.html:
Time in band
How long it stayed
where you wanted it
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: It flags oscillation, output saturation and valve reversals, the trouble that wastes energy and wears out valves.
scenes.html:
What it flags
Oscillation
Output saturation
Valve reversals
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Step-response metrics give a first-order-plus-dead-time estimate and a SIMC P I tuning starting point.
scenes.html:
A place to start tuning
FOPDT estimate
+ SIMC PI tuning starting point
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Cross-correlation between tags finds the lag and the dead time.
scenes.html:
Lag and dead time
Cross-correlation
between any two tags
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Dead time is the delay before the process even starts to respond. A loop tuned without knowing it tends to overshoot and swing.
scenes.html:
Why dead time matters
Ignore the delay,
get the swing.
Dead time is the wait before the process responds.
Syon Automation LLC
